title: Reports
description: Places that users reported as no longer existing. A report never takes a place off the map: you decide. When it is uncertain, keep the place.

empty.title: No open reports
empty.description: When users report that a place is gone, it appears here.

community.title: Delete this community place?
community.description: The place is deleted together with its confirmations, reports and favorites. This cannot be undone; your decision and reason are kept.

municipal.title: Hide this municipal place?
municipal.description: The place disappears from the map and stays hidden after later imports. You can show it again under municipal data.
